change.summary: Add independent direct shadows from native emissive blocks and the sun to nearby opaque terrain.

rationale.purpose: Extend the approved lighting preview to playable terrain while retaining native block emission and sky light inputs.
rationale.decision_source: User requested ordinary Embeddium chunks, emissive blocks and simultaneous sunlight in Sandbox only, on Windows and macOS. The local voxel volume, solid pass and eight-source budget are implementation choices.

introduced.summary: Apply original terrain lighting during opaque Embeddium chunk draws.

history.summary: Extend the scene to native block emission and opaque terrain.

notes: No gameplay registrations, server state or native block emission levels change. The standalone preview remains available.
unresolved: Visual output and frame time require verification on Windows and macOS. Partial block casters, LOD, entities and held lights are outside this pass.
